verdict.rationale: Docs confirm an Events API that tracks user activity per subscriber and can trigger automations, and flows explicitly built from 'behavior, events, and tags' with per-branch checks, matching the story of firing a custom event to trigger an automation for a specific person. missing for 10: no hands-on/independent confirmation of exact event-to-person targeting behavior, and no code sample showing the custom event payload triggering a single-subscriber automation.
